definitions.AutomaticIngress: Host invokes ARE for supported user events without an assistant tool request.
definitions.FeedbackCandidate: An attributed interpretation that has not necessarily become reusable guidance.
definitions.LearnedChange: A scoped successor derived from explicit feedback and an observed episode.
definitions.Application: Request-bound selection revalidated against current checkpointed controls at dispatch.
definitions.CapabilityProposal: A testable gap and proposed improvement, not code execution.
definitions.CutoverWatermark: Boundary between existing conversation context and ARE-observed future events.
definitions.HookObservation: Simulated native-shaped event whose session, workspace and transcript match an isolated configuration; not authenticated native provenance.
definitions.HookDelivery: Durably recorded projection emitted on stdout; actual model delivery remains unknown.
definitions.ExplicitPreferenceCommand: Exact allowlisted control syntax interpreted without a model or arbitrary instruction promotion.

product_prototype: Continue the existing conversation with automatic, inspectable adaptation to user corrections.
business_prototype: Fewer repeated corrections at measured total cost; unproved hypothesis.

domainspec_prototype.coverage: Subset only: hook emission is not full gateway dispatch enforcement.

compiled_system_prototype.reuse: Existing reducers and provenance operations; do not introduce a second memory model.

implementation_prototype: adapter.mjs maps isolated hook payloads to the existing ARE lifecycle and persistent reasoning ledger.
product_test: adapter.test.mjs: real subprocess and file-ledger integration with simulated host events; no model calls.
